label: Push-right shifting in a row
subgoals: Compute the new right edge of the edited cell
Move each later cell to the larger of its old x and its neighbour's right edge
Count the cells whose position changed

label: Where a pushed cell lands
subgoals: Start the pushed run at the edited cell's new right edge
Add each pushed cell's width to place the next one
Stop at the first gap that absorbs the remaining push

label: Total displacement and when to stop
section: Total displacement and when to stop
subgoals: Subtract old from new x for every moved cell
Sum the shifts into the total displacement
Bound the repair window so the update stays local
